Government of Karnataka
Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Haveri Disrict Haveri
No:KAMGRA.CR:21/2023-24
Date:12-10-2023.
Notification
Form-2E(sub-rule(3)of rule 9-B)

Whereas, the Assistant Commissioner of Haveri subdivision after conducting spot
inspection has submitted a proposal for declaration of unrecorded habitation in respect of habitation
situated Shiddeshwaranagar, Haveri taluk.
I the Deputy Commissioner of Haveri district, having examined the said proposal of
Assistant Commissioner and having satisfied that the same meets the criterion prescribed to declare
the said Shiddeshwaranagar unrecorded habitation as such, in exercise of the powers conffered
under section 38A of the Karnataka Land Reforms Act, 1961, hereby declare the following areas as
an unrecorded habitation, namely

It is hereby declared that this unrecorded habitation may here in after be named as
Shiddeshwaranagar.
And whereas inconsequence of this declaration the extent of land indicated in the column (4)
above with survey number specified in column (3) on which the said unrecorded habitation is
located vests absolutely in State Government free from all encumbrance.
Provided that, any private land vested in the Government as per this notification is
subject to the condition that any extent of such land occupied by the land owner himself for his
residential and other domestic purpose, if identified or included in it, the same shall be restored to
him by the Assistant Commissioner at the time of identifying eligible claimants for issuing title
deeds to the habitants of the said unrecorded habitation.
Place: Haveri
Date: 12-10-2023
Sd/-
